main_body: round wooden podium drum: a large tan elliptical top with a short darker front wall, and a small sign on a pole standing on it
top_band: light tan ellipse (L~152) rows 13-24, closed by a gold front-edge row at 25
evidence: At x=16 the scan shows an outline at row 12, then a light tan top surface (rows 13-24) with a gold edge line at row 25. Below it the front face (rows 26-30, L~124) is darker, a step of about 28 L. At x=23 the front drops to L=96. The ellipse silhouette is wide and clearly wider than the foreshortened front, so the top is a real horizontal surface, not a rim. The front wall is short, plain and has no inset details or eave shadow, but the large rounded top and the separate front wall read as a correct 3/4 drum. The sign and pole are small details and are not judged.

style.evidence: The candidate has 17 distinct colours against 38-40 in the references. It has 6 colours per tile against 17-20, and 36% flat-fill coverage against 13% and 0%. The tan top is a large, nearly uniform fill with no grain, and the front is a flat brown block with only a few highlight pixels. The outline is a tinted dark brown (0% neutral), which is acceptable. The piece is clearly shallower and flatter than the stall and well references.
